title: Product and iterated derived internal bars, with augmentation normalization
statement:
Let $A$ be a commutative condensed ring [sk-def-sfb-condensed-ring], and let $G,H$ be profinite groups. Use the Grothendieck abelian categories $\mathcal A_1(A),\mathcal A_G(A),\mathcal A_{G\times H}(A)$ of internal modules with condensed-group actions and the exact inflation adjunctions of [lem-sfb-condensed-product-action-inflation]. Let $N$ be any $G\times H$-equivariant internal $A$-module, in degree zero. All derived functors are ordinary K-injective derived functors [sk-def-sfb-derived-categories]. Write $A[P]$ for the free internal $A$-module on the condensed set represented by a profinite set $P$, and $R\underline{\operatorname{Hom}}_A$ for internal module Hom derived in its second variable. For $a,b\ge0$ form the derived bicosimplicial bar with terms
$$B^{a,b}(N)=R\underline{\operatorname{Hom}}_A(A[G^a\times H^b],N),$$
with the $G$- and $H$-inhomogeneous bar faces (first faces act on $N$) and degeneracies. Its totalization uses compatible nonnegative resolutions, with differential $d_G+(-1)^a d_H+(-1)^{a+b}d_{\rm res}$. Write $\operatorname{Tot}_\Delta$ for the totalization of its diagonal, whose degree $n$ term is identified with $R\underline{\operatorname{Hom}}_A(A[(G\times H)^n],N)$ by reordering coordinates.
There are natural derived identifications
$$\operatorname{Tot}_\Delta B(N)\cong R\Gamma_{G\times H}(N[0]),\qquad
\operatorname{Tot}_a\operatorname{Tot}_b B^{a,b}(N)\cong R\Gamma_G\bigl(R\Gamma_H^G(N[0])\bigr),$$
where the inner invariants retain the $G$-action. The diagonal-to-iterated comparison given by the augmented product group nerve and its two successive augmentations, with $H$ first and $G$ second, corresponds under these identifications to the right-derived comparison
$$R\Gamma_{G\times H}(N[0])\longrightarrow R\Gamma_G R\Gamma_H^G(N[0])$$
induced by $N^{G\times H}=(N^H)^G$ and the specified inflation adjunctions. These are statements in the derived category of internal $A$-modules, including the comparison arrow. They are natural in $N$ and include either group trivial and $N=0$. No underived continuous-function complex is substituted for derived internal Hom.
